name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 7 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2025-06-03, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
